note: CH-10 replicate, not a new baseline: exactly the settings of yolo_baseline_marko_3050 (CH-09, RTX 3050), re-run on the RTX 5070 that trains the CH-10 variants. Purpose: measure how much the same configuration moves between GPUs / non-deterministic CUDA kernels, so variant-vs-baseline differences can be read against that spread. The CH-09 run stays the reference baseline.
